en: Maggārammaṇattika (The Triplet on Having the Path as Object)

Dependent on a state that does not have the Path as its object … pe … dependent on a state that does not have the Path as its root … pe … dependent on a state that does not have the Path as its predominance … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are forty-nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are forty-nine.
